title: JFK asks McCone for a full UFO briefing on June 5, 1963
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of JFK asks McCone for a full UFO briefing on June 5, 1963, about 1963 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he contacts McCone the new CIA director because he'd already forced into retirement Dulles and he says he wants to get fully briefed in on the UFO stuff.

related.note: Both are about JFK asking CIA Director McCone for UFO information in 1963. This telling has it as a request for a full briefing on June 5, 1963, while the story has it as a letter dated November 12, 1963.

plain: A speaker named Dan Sheehan says that on June 5, 1963, President John F. Kennedy contacted John McCone, the new head of the CIA, the US spy agency, after pushing the old head, Allen Dulles, into retirement. According to Sheehan, Kennedy said he wanted to be fully briefed on everything about UFOs. If true, it would mean a sitting president was pressing his spies for the UFO secrets.
